meta.macro_lag: 1 extra trading day on every macro input; weights lag 1 (common.backtest)
meta.decision_rule: INCLUDE iff Calmar&Sharpe up in both halves AND IS Calmar gain > 0.15 AND (p(Sharpe diff<=0)<0.05 or p(CAGR diff vs vol-matched dial<=0)<0.05); MARGINAL iff both halves and gain>0.07

noop.algebra: A & ~(I & ~A) = A & (~I | A) = (A & ~I) | (A & A) = (A & ~I) | A = A   (absorption law)
